about: Upstream sources the iDempiere skills of this distribution follow. Nothing from them is copied here: scripts/idempiere-upstream.js clones each one into a temporary directory and reports what changed since the pinned commit. Bump a pin only after reviewing the change and recording the decision (rsc-brain alge-idempiere, topic skills-upstream-sync).
